title: Tensor resonances in teleparallel Gauss-Bonnet branes
summary: We construct an analytical thick-brane solution in linear teleparallel Gauss-Bonnet gravity using a first-order formalism generated by a sine-Gordon superpotential. The resulting asymptotically $\mathrm{AdS}_5$ configurations exhibit brane splitting controlled by the dimensionless parameter $q=4αk^2$. An analytical splitting condition is derived and combined with tensor-stability requirements to identify the physically viable parameter region.
